o1: Enables nuclear receptor binding activity; protein serine/threonine kinase activator activity; and transcription coactivator activity. Contributes to protein kinase activity. Involved in axis specification; digestive tract development; and positive regulation of protein localization. Is located in cell cortex and nucleus. Is part of serine/threonine protein kinase complex and the canonical Wnt signaling pathway. Is expressed in AB; E; EMS; P0; and linker cell.
